name: Marketing Cloud Administrator
notes: Banco de 96 preguntas de pruebas reales de Marketing Cloud Administrator (Sets 1 y 2, sin duplicados), con 3 opciones por pregunta. Las capturas eran de baja resolución, así que algún enunciado puede tener erratas menores. Las respuestas son las marcadas por quien hizo la prueba; las dudosas están corregidas y llevan una nota visible. Los pesos por área son los de la guía oficial; el 67 % de aprobado y los 105 min vienen de una fuente de terceros (no de Salesforce), así que tómalos como orientativos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters requires all subscriber files placed on the SFTP for import to be encrypted. Which activity in Automation Studio could be used to decrypt the file to prepare for importing?
o: Decryption Activity
Data Extract Activity
File Transfer Activity
questions.e: La actividad File Transfer permite descifrar el archivo cifrado del SFTP antes de la importación.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la B (Data Extract), pero Data Extract genera archivos, no los descifra; la actividad de Automation Studio que descifra el archivo antes de importar es File Transfer (C). Respuesta corregida: revísala si tienes la solución oficial.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to have specific permission restrictions applied to all users in a business unit. How should they accomplish this?
o: Set default permissions with the restrictions on the business unit.
Assign a role to the business unit.
Deny the permissions directly within the business unit.
questions.e: Se asigna un rol a la unidad de negocio, de modo que sus restricciones de permisos se apliquen a todos sus usuarios.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is asked by the marketing team to ensure a default Header and Footer be added to emails. Where under Setup could this be created?
o: Account Settings
Content Builder Settings
Email Static Settings
questions.e: La cabecera y el pie predeterminados de los correos se configuran en los ajustes de la cuenta (Account Settings), en Setup.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to segment audiences based on Sales Cloud data. Where would their Marketing Cloud admin configure Sales Cloud Objects to be synced and leveraged in Marketing Cloud?
o: Setup > Data Management > Synchronized Data Extensions
Contact Builder > Data Extensions > Synchronized Data Extensions
Contact Builder > Data Sources
questions.e: Los objetos de Sales Cloud a sincronizar se configuran en Contact Builder > Data Sources.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has been asked to update their account's SFTP user password. Where in Setup could they accomplish this task?
o: Data Management
Security
Users
questions.e: Las cuentas FTP, incluido el cambio de contraseña, se gestionan en Setup > Data Management.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) hired a new Marketing Cloud admin, who was told all emails come from info@email.nto.com. The previous admin did not leave any documentation. What should confirm a Sender Authentication Package (SAP) has been set up on the account?
o: Upon receiving an email, all tracked links start with click.email.nto.com.
Users receive Marketing Cloud password reset emails from help@email.nto.com.
The login page for Marketing Cloud Users is login.email.nto.com and is branded with NTO colors.
questions.e: Con un SAP configurado, los enlaces rastreados del correo usan el dominio de marca (por ejemplo click.email.nto.com).

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is tasked with requesting Marketing Cloud Connect Multi-Org enablement. What consideration should be given to the preference/profile centers for this integration?
o: Profile/preference centers are automatically created for each business unit connected through Multi-Org.
Branding for each business units' profile centers will be inherited from the default business unit setup.
Multi-Org does not support the standard profile/preference center for the business units.
questions.e: Multi-Org no admite el centro de perfil o preferencias estándar de las unidades de negocio.

questions.t: Informe de contenido en Triggered Send
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is asked to understand how a certain content area within a Triggered Send Email is performing. Which report should be used?
o: Impression Tracking for Triggered Sends
Account Send Summary
Dynamic Content for Triggered Sends
questions.e: Impression Tracking for Triggered Sends muestra el rendimiento de las áreas de contenido de un correo de envío disparado.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to create a suppression list for hard-bounced email addresses. Where could the details be found?
o: Email Studio Tracking Tab
Bounce Data View
Recent Email Sending Summary
questions.e: La vista de datos de rebotes (Bounce Data View) detalla las direcciones rebotadas y permite construir la lista de supresión.

questions.t: Modelo de datos en Data Designer
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is configuring the Marketing Cloud data model for the first time. Journey Builder will be used to personalize the type of messages being sent to customers, based on if there has been an order or not. There are two existing data extensions: Customers and Orders. Customers contains information about subscribers including Email Address, First Name, Last Name, Address, and Customer ID. Orders contains information about the orders and includes the unique identifier of the customer. How should Data Designer be configured to allow this data to be used within a Journey decision split?
o: Link the Customers data extension to the data model using Email Address.
Link the Customers data extension to the data model using a Many-to-One relationship.
Link the Customers data extension to the data model using Customer ID.
questions.e: Customers se vincula al modelo de datos por Customer ID, que es el identificador común con Orders y permite usar esos datos en el decision split.

questions.q: The Marketing Cloud admin for Northern Trails Outfitters wants to build an audience with Advertising Studio which mimics the traits of their most valuable customers. Which network supports lookalike audiences directly from Advertising Studio?
o: Google
Facebook
Twitter
questions.e: Advertising Studio permite crear audiencias similares (lookalike) directamente en Facebook.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin installed Query Studio for Marketing Cloud, however, users are reporting they do NOT have access. How should the Marketing Cloud admin ensure users have access?
o: Allow access package access on appropriate Roles
Configure the API Integration to allow all users access
License all appropriate users within the installed package
questions.e: Los usuarios deben tener licencia dentro del paquete instalado para poder usar la aplicación.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is building a journey which randomly sends five different versions of an initial welcome email to new subscribers; however, subscribers receive the same follow-up email two weeks later. To improve maintainability of their email content, NTO wants to use five completely different emails, rather than having one email with dynamic content. Which activity would allow them to build the journey with the lowest activities possible?
o: Path Optimizer Activity
Join Activity
Engagement Split
questions.e: Con una actividad Join, las cinco ramas del reparto aleatorio confluyen en un único correo de seguimiento, sin duplicar actividades.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) uses Sender Authentication Package (SAP) for branding purposes. Their German business unit is configured with the SAP domain de.ntomarketing.com. The new German team is preparing for a campaign and wants to use customized CloudPages with the domain de-special.ntomarketing.com. How could the Marketing Cloud admin meet this requirement?
o: Purchase a new SAP for de-special.ntomarketing.com.
CloudPages must use the SAP domain.
Purchase a new Private Domain for use in CloudPages.
questions.e: Para usar un dominio propio distinto en CloudPages no hace falta otro SAP: se compra un dominio privado (Private Domain) para esas páginas.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin needs to warm their account's Dedicated IP. What option for segmentation aligns with the IP Warming process?
o: Segment by domain to limit number of sends to each email provider.
Segment subscribers by subscriber opt-in date.
Segment subscribers with soft bounces in their own dedicated seed.
questions.e: Durante el calentamiento de IP se segmenta por dominio para limitar el volumen enviado a cada proveedor de correo.

questions.t: Datos de Sales Cloud en queries
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has been asked to include Sales Cloud data in their queries. Which feature would allow this functionality?
o: Journey Builder
Query Studio
Synchronized Data Sources
questions.e: Los orígenes de datos sincronizados traen los datos de Sales Cloud a Marketing Cloud para poder usarlos en queries.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to create an SFTP User for the first time. Which consideration should be taken when configuring an SFTP User?
o: By default, the username is the MID for the current Marketing Cloud MID.
Once created, the user will need to be activated to use the SFTP.
Once created, the password can only be updated by admin.
questions.e: Tras crear el usuario SFTP hay que activarlo antes de poder usar el servidor SFTP.

questions.q: A user asks a Marketing Cloud admin to update and increase their session timeout setting. Which consideration should the admin review before making this update?
o: Frustration of users upon timeouts
Change impacts all users
Typical length of time users spend in Marketing Cloud
questions.e: El tiempo de espera de sesión es un ajuste de cuenta, así que el cambio afecta a todos los usuarios.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) uses data extensions for all of their email audiences. A customer reports they updated their email address weeks ago but continues to receive the NTO Daily Digest email at their old address. The Marketing Cloud admin has confirmed the new email address is present in the appropriate data extension. What consideration could account for this behavior?
o: The email address in All Subscribers is prioritized.
The data extension was not configured as sendable.
Contact Builder was not configured properly.
questions.e: Si en All Subscribers consta la dirección antigua, esa dirección tiene prioridad en el envío frente a la de la extensión de datos.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin at Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is exploring whether they need to separate their brands into separate business units. When should the admin create separate business units for each of NTO's brands?
o: A new sender profile is needed for sending transactional emails.
Brand-specific private domains are required for images and links.
Multiple FTP users must be accommodated.
questions.e: Hacen falta unidades de negocio separadas cuando cada marca necesita sus propios dominios privados para imágenes y enlaces.

questions.q: What does Marketing Cloud authenticate when a user logs in through the user interface?
o: If the user is assigned a role in the parent business unit
If the user is logging in within defined Business Hours
If the user is logging in from an allowlisted IP address
questions.e: Marketing Cloud puede comprobar si el usuario accede desde una dirección IP incluida en la lista de permitidas.

questions.q: Security and Legal teams determine subscriber data available to EMEA teams should NOT be available to AMER teams. How could the Marketing Cloud admin ensure distinct data integrity across the regions?
o: Filter data view permissions at the subscriber level.
Deploy Multi-Org with a single Marketing Cloud Account.
Separate regions into business units and apply Subscriber Filters.
questions.e: Se separan las regiones en unidades de negocio distintas y se aplican filtros de suscriptor para aislar los datos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters' security team has password policies they want enforced within Marketing Cloud. Which password policies could the Marketing Cloud admin configure in Setup?
o: Maximum Password Length, Password Complexity, Unique Password, Expiration Period
Minimum Password Length, Use Strong Passphrases, Password History, Number of Security Questions
Minimum Password Length, Password Complexity, Password History, Expiration Period
questions.e: En Setup se pueden configurar la longitud mínima, la complejidad, el historial de contraseñas y el periodo de caducidad.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses DoubleClick Bid Manager, Facebook Ads, and Google Analytics to manage advertising spend. They want to combine these data sources with Marketing Cloud's API to identify their most effective campaigns. What feature should be recommended?
o: Interaction Studio
Einstein AI
Datorama
questions.e: Datorama integra datos de plataformas publicitarias y de analítica para medir qué campañas son más eficaces.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has been asked to grant full administrator permissions to a new user. Which two standard roles should be selected for the new user?
o: Administrator and Marketing Cloud Administrator
Data Manager and Marketing Cloud Administrator
Marketing Cloud Security Administrator and Administrator
questions.e: Los permisos completos de administrador se conceden con los roles Administrator y Marketing Cloud Administrator.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has noticed a File Drop Automation has been failing on the Import File activity. The automation is configured with a filename pattern, so the filename is expected to begin with customer_import_. The import is configured to look for a file named customer_import_%%Year%%%%Month%%%%Day%%.csv, however, the admin notices the filenames include seconds and milliseconds. How should the admin fix the issue?
o: Use %%Filename_From_Trigger%% in the Import File Activity
Use %%_DataSourceName%% in the Import File Activity
Use the exact filename used for the trigger in the Import File Activity
questions.e: %%Filename_From_Trigger%% usa el nombre real del archivo que disparó la automatización, sea cual sea su sufijo de fecha y hora.

questions.q: Where would a Marketing Cloud admin view all verified email addresses?
o: Sender Profiles
Identity Verification Log
From Address Management
questions.e: En From Address Management se consultan todas las direcciones de correo verificadas.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is asked to add a set of four query strings automatically to all the links in an email sent via Email Studio. Which solution should the admin suggest?
o: Parameter Manager
AMPscript for Marketing Cloud
Google Analytics 360
questions.e: Parameter Manager añade automáticamente cadenas de consulta a todos los enlaces del email.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to copy journeys across business units. What could be used to replicate journey structure so it can be easily recreated in another account?
o: Package Manager
Journey Extracts
Journey Templates
questions.e: Package Manager empaqueta la estructura del journey para recrearla en otra unidad de negocio o cuenta.

questions.t: Orígenes de entrada de Journey Builder
questions.q: What are entry source types for Journey Builder?
o: Data Extension, CloudPages, Email List, API Event
Data Extension, Audience Studio, API Event, Date Based Event
Data Extension, Email List, API Event, Date Based Event
questions.e: Entre los orígenes de entrada de Journey Builder están las extensiones de datos, Audience Studio y los eventos de API y de fecha.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses Marketing Cloud Connect to leverage Sales Cloud data in their Journeys. A user recently reported the data coming from Sales Cloud is NOT up to date. Where should the Marketing Cloud admin begin troubleshooting?
o: Setup > Synchronized Data Extensions
Contact Builder > Data Sources
Contact Builder > Synchronized Data Extensions
questions.e: La sincronización se revisa en Contact Builder > Data Sources, donde se ve el estado de los orígenes de datos conectados.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is using the Import Wizard to import data into a non-sendable data extension, but receives an error indicating the import type being used requires a primary key. Which import type could the admin use instead?
o: Overwrite
Add Only
Add and Update
questions.e: Add and Update y Add Only requieren clave primaria; Overwrite no, así que sirve para una extensión sin ella.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to leverage the REST API for an external application they plan to build. Where should their Marketing Cloud admin set up permissions to allow REST authentication?
o: Installed Packages
Data Management
Salesforce Integration
questions.e: Los permisos de autenticación para la API REST se configuran creando un paquete instalado (Installed Package) en Setup.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants a data model in Marketing Cloud which will prevent them from duplicating, or even triplicating, records. How should the unique identifier of the data model be set up if the MobilePush and Email channels are used within the same account?
o: Use the auto-generated keys supplied by Marketing Cloud at time of record creation for each channel used.
Use a third-party system to identify and delete duplicate Contact Keys.
Strategically control the Contact Key values and tie records together across channels using this key.
questions.e: Se controlan los valores de Contact Key y se usa esa clave para unir los registros de todos los canales en un único contacto.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has been asked to get the last 30 days of Bounce data from their account. What should the admin use to get granular bounce data in bulk in a pre-defined format?
o: CSV download of bounce data in My Tracking
Sent Data View Query
Automation Studio Tracking Extract
questions.e: El Tracking Extract de Automation Studio entrega datos de seguimiento detallados y masivos en un formato predefinido.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants a business analyst to import contact lists. The analyst has the following Marketing Cloud roles: Marketing Cloud Channel Manager and Marketing Cloud Viewer. The analyst logged in but is unable to import contact lists. How should the user be updated to allow the analyst the appropriate access?
o: Remove Marketing Cloud Viewer
Add Distributed Sending User
Add Marketing Cloud Security Administrator
questions.e: El rol Viewer es de solo lectura y limita los permisos del Channel Manager; quitándolo, el analista puede importar.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to configure a new keyword for an upcoming SMS campaign. After entering the desired keyword (CELEBRATE) the admin notices the keyword is unavailable. What issue could the admin be facing?
o: Keyword is used within another business unit
Keyword fails to meet content standards
Keyword is a reserved word
questions.e: Una palabra clave de SMS debe ser única para el código corto; si ya la usa otra unidad de negocio, no está disponible.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has configured a Tracking Extract which includes all subscriber attributes for their global regions. However, the admin notices accented characters in the customers' names appear jumbled in the extracted file. Which setting could solve this issue?
o: Change Column Delimiter to |
Change Format to xml
Change Character Encoding to UTF-8
questions.e: Los caracteres acentuados se corrompen por la codificación; cambiarla a UTF-8 los conserva en el archivo extraído.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin discovers large sends are not meeting send speed goals set by the organization. What functionality would get messages out the door faster?
o: Send Throttling
Journey Builder
Burst Sending
questions.e: Burst Sending acelera los envíos grandes, mientras que el Send Throttling ralentiza el ritmo.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has imported a file into All Subscribers. They then received a results file stating an example.com address could NOT be imported. Which error code would the file contain for this record?
o: List Detective
Skipped Records
Restricted Values
questions.e: List Detective bloquea direcciones que se consideran inválidas o de riesgo, como las de dominios de ejemplo, y lo indica en el archivo de resultados.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin notices Individual Email Results are NOT being pushed back to Sales Cloud for a particular send. The admin confirms Marketing Cloud Connect is functioning properly. What should the admin confirm about the data extension?
o: The data extension is located in the Salesforce Data Extensions folder.
The send relationship links SubscriberKey to Subscribers on EmailAddress.
The data extension is located in the Synchronized Data Extensions folder.
questions.e: Para devolver los resultados individuales a Sales Cloud, la extensión de datos debe estar en la carpeta Salesforce Data Extensions.

questions.t: Datos personales fuera de Marketing Cloud
questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters does NOT want to store email addresses or phone numbers within Marketing Cloud. Which feature should they use?
o: Field Level Encryption
Lookup reference to Contact Object
Tokenized Sending
questions.e: Tokenized Sending evita almacenar direcciones de correo o teléfonos en Marketing Cloud: se envían con un token y la dirección real se resuelve fuera.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin has scheduled a query on a daily basis. They notice the query sometimes fails to execute. How would the admin ensure a notification is received when the query fails?
o: Configure the "Event Notification Service" in Setup with their Email Address
Verify their Email Address in Alert Manager within the Setup app
Add their Email Address in the automation notification settings
questions.e: Las notificaciones de error de una query programada se configuran en los ajustes de notificación de la automatización.

questions.q: To prevent retention of stagnant data, Northern Trail Outfitters wants any inactive data stored in data extensions to be cleared after 12 months. What action should be taken?
o: Set inactive data to be automatically cleared after one year, but is recoverable
Configure the business unit data retention setting to 12 months
Apply a Row Based Retention to each data extension as it is created, set to 12 months
questions.e: La retención por filas se define en cada extensión de datos al crearla, por ejemplo a 12 meses, y elimina los registros antiguos.

questions.q: Which statement should be considered before using Goals in Journey Builder?
o: Contacts are evaluated against the goal after each wait activity.
Goal target statistics are stored in a data extension.
Each contact can be assigned an individual goal.
questions.e: Los contactos se evalúan contra el objetivo (Goal) después de cada actividad de espera, y esto condiciona cómo se diseña el journey.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to ensure sensitive information needed for email sends is NOT imported and stored in Marketing Cloud. What solution might they implement?
o: Data At Rest Encryption
Field Level Encryption
Tokenized Sending
questions.e: Con Tokenized Sending los datos sensibles (como el correo o el teléfono) se quedan en el sistema del cliente y Marketing Cloud solo gestiona un token.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to ensure email sends exclude their testing prefix of [PREVIEW] in the subject line when deploying from Email Studio. What should the admin do to prevent the prefix from deploying in live sends?
o: Wrap the subject line with AMPscript
Use Proof instead of [PREVIEW]
Add [PREVIEW] to the subject line validation list
questions.e: Añadir [PREVIEW] a la lista de validación del asunto hace que Email Studio bloquee los envíos que lo contengan.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is preparing to send a promotional email. The audience file was loaded into a data extension but it does not display for the Marketing Cloud admin when scheduling the send. What should the admin confirm to resolve the issue?
o: The data extension is linked using the Contact Key.
The data extension is marked as Sendable.
The data extension is marked as Sendable and Testable.
questions.e: Para aparecer como audiencia en un envío, la extensión de datos debe estar marcada como Sendable.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters uses Parameter Manager to automatically tag links. They want to include a Campaign Identifier to the links within a specific campaign message. At which level should the utm_campaign value be configured?
o: Account
Email
Link
questions.e: Para que el identificador de campaña afecte a los enlaces de un mensaje concreto, el valor utm_campaign se configura a nivel de email.

questions.q: Which data structure could be configured to appear in the out-of-the-box Subscription Center?
o: Data Extensions
Publication Lists
Groups
questions.e: El Subscription Center predeterminado muestra las listas de publicación, para que cada suscriptor gestione a cuáles está suscrito.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la A (Data Extensions), pero el centro de suscripciones predeterminado muestra las listas de publicación (B). Respuesta corregida: revísala si tienes la solución oficial.

questions.q: What elements of CAN-SPAM should the Marketing Cloud admin ensure are present for each Commercial send?
o: Preference Center link and physical mailing address
Preference Center link and a link to the business website
Business name and physical mailing address
questions.e: Todo envío comercial debe incluir un mecanismo de baja (enlace al centro de preferencias) y una dirección postal física.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to send a custom survey to customers asking about their experience following a recent purchase. Which feature should be used to create a survey form?
o: Smart Capture
Interaction Studio
Analytics Builder
questions.e: Smart Capture permite crear formularios, como una encuesta, que guardan las respuestas en una extensión de datos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) purchased one Sender Authentication Package (SAP) to ensure their branding is on every marketing communication. What would be achieved with SAP?
o: A Dedicated IP is automatically warmed up
The out-of-the-box profile center will display NTO branding
Image URLs are wrapped with the appropriate brand URL
questions.e: El SAP permite usar dominios propios, de modo que las URL de imágenes y enlaces llevan la marca del cliente.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has a mobile app. Which product would allow them to send push notifications to customers with their mobile app?
o: Journey Builder
Group Connect
Content Builder
questions.e: Journey Builder, junto con MobilePush, permite orquestar el envío de notificaciones push a la app móvil.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to use Synchronized Data Sources to sync Contact data from Salesforce CRM. However, they only want to sync records they would be able to send to to reduce the amount of data brought over. Which filtering option could be used when configuring the Contact synced object?
o: Select all records which are active in All Subscribers
Select all records where HasOptedOutOfEmail is FALSE
Select all records where EmailOptInStatus is 'ACTIVE'
questions.e: El filtro de la fuente sincronizada se define con campos del objeto de Salesforce; HasOptedOutOfEmail = FALSE deja fuera a quienes no se les puede enviar.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la A, pero el filtro de un objeto sincronizado se aplica sobre campos del objeto de Salesforce, no sobre All Subscribers; lo coherente es HasOptedOutOfEmail = FALSE (B). Respuesta corregida: revísala si tienes la solución oficial.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters runs a nightly automation consisting of a File Transfer and a File Import. Following an update from the engineering team, the automation began failing. The Marketing Cloud admin suspects the CSV file now has an invalid format. How could the admin receive a file of the bad data rows to confirm this theory?
o: Update the Import definition to include a notification email address.
Move the Import definition to its own automation and include a notification email address.
Move the File Transfer to its own automation and include a notification email address.
questions.e: Añadiendo un correo de notificación a la definición de importación, la plataforma envía el archivo con las filas erróneas.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is a global brand that includes many subsidiary brands under the parent umbrella. NTO is the Enterprise business unit and also has a child business unit used for sending promotional emails. How should the rest of the business unit be organized?
o: Create a single child business unit for the other brands to share and standardized naming conventions.
Create child business units for each brand and next another level of child business units for GEOs.
Create new Enterprise business units for each brand and child business units for each of the brand's GEOs.
questions.e: Se crea una única unidad de negocio hija que compartan las demás marcas y se estandarizan las convenciones de nombres.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters was given a set of requirements from their governance team to protect against misuse of customer data. One item mandated Marketing Cloud users should NOT be able to export data without approval from the governance team, however, users should still be able to view data within the system. Which feature would allow compliance with this requirement?
o: Export Email Allowlist
IP Allowlist
Audit Trail
questions.e: La lista de correos permitidos para exportación (Export Email Allowlist) restringe a quién se pueden enviar las exportaciones, sin impedir que los usuarios vean los datos.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters just purchased Marketing Cloud. Which task would the Marketing Cloud admin be guided through in Setup Assistant?
o: Building the data structure used to store audience information
Importing data into contacts using the Data Loader
Creating a SMS message and sending a mobile campaign
questions.e: El Setup Assistant guía en la configuración inicial de la cuenta, incluida la estructura de datos que almacenará la información de la audiencia.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters only has enough licenses for their staff. A campaign manager is out on parental leave. How should they create a new user to fill in?
o: Clone the campaign manager's user to a new user.
Disable the campaign manager's user and create a new user.
Deactivate the campaign manager's license and assign it to a new user.
questions.e: Como no hay licencias de sobra, se deshabilita el usuario del gestor ausente para liberar su licencia y se crea un usuario nuevo.

questions.q: A Northern Trail Outfitters' (NTO) subscriber clicks a link in an NTO email. Prior to clicking, the subscriber had a bounced status in Marketing Cloud. What would be the effects of the click on the subscriber's status?
o: Status is changed to Active and the bounce count is set to zero
Status remains as Bounced and the bounce count is unchanged
Status is changed to Held for 72 hours and the bounce count is set to zero
questions.e: Un clic demuestra que el suscriptor está activo: pasa a Active y el contador de rebotes vuelve a cero.

questions.q: Which activity should be used for multivariate content testing within Journey Builder?
o: Engagement Split
Random Split
Decision Split
questions.e: La Random Split reparte a los contactos al azar entre variantes, lo que permite probar contenidos en Journey Builder.

questions.q: A user asks a Marketing Cloud admin to review their permissions since they are unable to send an email. The admin reviews the user account and notices the user has three roles assigned: Content Creator, Data Manager, and Marketing Cloud Viewer. What should the admin do to resolve the issue so the user can send an email?
o: Remove the Marketing Cloud Viewer Role
Add the Marketing Cloud Administrator role
Edit permissions and Grant permissions to Send
questions.e: Según la captura, se editan los permisos del usuario para concederle el permiso de envío.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to decrease its Session Timeout from 8 hours to 20 minutes. Where should this update be made?
o: Setup > Platform Tools > Feature Settings
Setup > Company Settings > Account Settings
Setup > Security > Security Settings
questions.e: El tiempo de sesión se ajusta en Setup > Security > Security Settings.

questions.t: Marketing Cloud para usuarios de Sales Cloud
questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to expand their use of Marketing Cloud to business users who spend their day in Sales Cloud, without granting access to Marketing Cloud directly. What feature should be used?
o: Distributed Sending
Marketing Cloud Connect
Distributed Marketing
questions.e: Distributed Marketing permite a los usuarios de Sales Cloud lanzar comunicaciones sin acceder directamente a Marketing Cloud.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la B (Marketing Cloud Connect), pero lo que permite a usuarios de Sales Cloud lanzar campañas sin acceso a Marketing Cloud es Distributed Marketing (C). Respuesta corregida: revísala.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) is warming a new Dedicated IP address, and they need to monitor deliverability across major ISPs. Which bounce type would be indicative of the ISP's view of their sending reputation?
o: Block
Soft
Technical
questions.e: Los rebotes de tipo Block reflejan que el ISP rechaza el envío por la reputación del remitente.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) has expanded marketing efforts globally and wants to implement a Dedicated IP, which is included in their Sender Authentication Package. NTO plans to share it across each of their Marketing Cloud accounts. Which consideration would help determine if a Dedicated IP is the correct choice?
o: Length of time needed to pause sending is greater than one month
Send volume is large enough to maintain a positive or neutral reputation
Pre-warmed IP address can be purchased from Salesforce
questions.e: Una IP dedicada solo compensa si el volumen de envío es suficiente para mantener una reputación positiva o neutra.

questions.q: Einstein Recommendations uses data extensions to store user-facing information. How is this data passed to Marketing Cloud?
o: Collect Tracking Code
Google Analytics
Web & Mobile Analytics
questions.e: Los datos del sitio se envían a Marketing Cloud mediante el Collect Tracking Code.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is asked to determine the total number of emails sent across all of their business units in the last calendar year. Where would the admin retrieve this information?
o: Analytics Builder > Reports > Email Send Report
Email Studio > Email > Tracking > Sends
Einstein > Einstein Messaging Insights > Reporting
questions.e: Analytics Builder permite informes a nivel de cuenta, incluidas todas las unidades de negocio.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin runs the Contacts Counts report and sees there are currently 500,000 contacts in their account. They have a total of 300,000 email subscribers, 200,000 synchronized contacts, and 75,000 mobile subscribers. Why would the total contact count be less than the total number of contacts from all data sources?
o: There are overlapping contacts in each of the channels.
Synchronized contacts are only counted after sending.
Mobile subscribers are not counted as contacts.
questions.e: Un mismo contacto puede estar en varios canales y se cuenta una sola vez, por eso el total es menor que la suma.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la B, pero la suma de canales (575.000) supera los 500.000 porque un mismo contacto aparece en varios canales (A). Respuesta corregida: revísala.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) rolled out a global SMS initiative three months ago, as their customers have shown great interest in receiving promotions via text. However, NTO was notified they are already at 75% utilization for their annual Super Messages. Why could this be the case?
o: A multiplier is applied to each SMS message based on the destination country.
MobilePush was enabled by mistake, which consumes Super Messages when not in use.
Each email consumes five Super Messages when sending below a certain threshold.
questions.e: Los SMS consumen Super Messages con un multiplicador según el país de destino, lo que explica el consumo elevado.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la C, pero habla de emails y la pregunta es sobre SMS; el consumo de Super Messages varía con un multiplicador por país de destino (A). Respuesta corregida: revísala.

questions.t: Asignar usuarios a unidades de negocio
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is setting up Northern Trail Outfitters' newest business units and several users to assign to the new business units. How would the admin assign users to the business units?
o: Search for the individual user, select their name, and click Manage Business Units.
Search for the individual user, select their name, and click Edit Business Units.
Give permissions to users at the top-level account to assign their own business units.
questions.e: Según la captura, se dan permisos a los usuarios en la cuenta de nivel superior para que asignen sus propias unidades de negocio.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is concerned about unauthorized API access to their Marketing Cloud account. Which feature would they enable to assist in reducing threats from malicious API attacks?
o: Multi-Factor Authentication
IP Login Allowlist
SSH Key Management
questions.e: La IP Login Allowlist limita el acceso a direcciones IP autorizadas y reduce las amenazas de ataques a la API.

questions.q: While setting up Marketing Cloud Connect, a Marketing Cloud admin navigates to the Marketing Cloud tab in Sales Cloud to complete the integration. The admin then receives the following error message: Insufficient User Permissions. You have not been designated as an integrated Marketing Cloud user. Contact your system administrator. The admin notices the Marketing Cloud for AppExchange Admin option is selected when looking at the user settings. What action should correct the issue?
o: Apply the appropriate user mappings in the CRM configuration
Apply the Marketing Cloud for AppExchange User option as well
Apply the Connected App Authentication permission
questions.e: El usuario necesita también la opción Marketing Cloud for AppExchange User, además de la de administrador.

questions.t: Bloquear el acceso a la API
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to ensure no one could access the API with their Marketing Cloud user credentials. Which security setting would control this behavior?
o: Deselect 'Enable Username and Password for Web Services'
Select 'Identity Verification'
Enable MFA on Users accounts
questions.e: Desmarcar 'Enable Username and Password for Web Services' impide usar las credenciales de usuario para acceder a la API.

questions.t: Extensión de datos del Send Log
questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to set up their Send Log data extension. Which consideration should be made for long-term success?
o: Apply an appropriately-scoped Data Retention period.
Set the period to a fixed date in the Data Retention Policy.
Log any variable data captured in emails at send time.
questions.e: El Send Log crece sin parar, así que conviene aplicar un periodo de retención de datos bien dimensionado.

questions.q: Which product enables a Marketing Cloud admin to observe customer behavior, build preference profiles, and deliver the next-best content?
o: Einstein Email Recommendations
Einstein Content Selection
Interactive Email Form Block
questions.e: Según la captura, el producto que observa el comportamiento, crea perfiles de preferencias y entrega el siguiente mejor contenido es Einstein Email Recommendations.

questions.q: A new employee is hired into the role of marketing analyst. This user should have access to all tracking data in all channels, but no access to any send activities. Which two default User Roles should be applied to this new user which provides this access to all channels, keeping the principle of least privilege in mind?
o: Analyst and Marketing Cloud Viewer
Data Manager and Analyst
Content Creator and Marketing Cloud Viewer
questions.e: Analyst y Marketing Cloud Viewer dan acceso al seguimiento de todos los canales sin permisos de envío, respetando el mínimo privilegio.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters has been noticing reduced deliverability when they do large sends. Which part of deliverability is tied to hitting Spam Traps during a send?
o: Sender Authentication
Content
List Hygiene
questions.e: Las spam traps se alcanzan al enviar a listas sin depurar, por lo que el factor implicado es la higiene de la lista.
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la A (Sender Authentication), pero las spam traps se asocian a listas sin depurar; la respuesta correcta es List Hygiene (C).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters (NTO) wants to limit who can receive Marketing Cloud tracking data via email to their domain (ntoretail.com). Which step should be taken to implement this?
o: Limit export permissions
Add a Domain to the Export Email Allowlist
Enable IP Allowlist
questions.e: Se añade el dominio a la Export Email Allowlist para que los datos de seguimiento solo puedan enviarse a direcciones de ese dominio.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is configuring a journey using Path Optimizer. They want to hold back 60% of the contacts until a winner has been selected. What is required to configure the Holdback percentage?
o: No more than two paths
Run Once schedule type
Evaluation period must be 72 hours
questions.e: Según la captura, el holdback en Path Optimizer requiere el tipo de programación Run Once.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is tasked with overhauling the data model for Enterprise. While the current data model is isolated to the Email channel, there are plans to expand to both SMS and Push channels in the near future. Which data preparation should be made to retain high data quality in the new model?
o: Ensure every data source has a sendable field.
Identify and assign appropriate keys to tie records together.
Confirm all available data is included.
questions.e: Para mantener la calidad del dato en varios canales hay que identificar y asignar claves adecuadas que enlacen los registros.

questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters has Marketing Cloud users who need data extension View and Update permissions for campaigns related to B2C sales, but not any permissions for campaigns related to B2B sales. How should they accomplish this?
o: Create a new business unit
Update data extension object level permissions
Create separate folders and add permissions
questions.e: Se ajustan los permisos a nivel de objeto en cada extensión de datos para dar ver y actualizar solo en las de B2C.

questions.t: Clave de suscriptor en Marketing Cloud Connect
questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to check the status of a Salesforce contact in All Subscribers. The account is connected to their Salesforce org via Marketing Cloud Connect. Which subscriber key should be used to search for the contact in All Subscribers?
o: 15-digit Contact ID
Email Address
18-digit Contact ID
questions.e: Con Marketing Cloud Connect, la clave de suscriptor es el ID de contacto de Salesforce de 18 dígitos.

questions.t: Decision Split tras entrar al journey
questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters wants subscribers in their Onboarding Journey to move along a unique path if they purchase within the first 10 days of registration. An hourly automation is run which updates the Entry Source data extension with a field indicating if the subscriber made a purchase during this time. What should be confirmed to ensure Journey Builder directs the subscribers correctly?
o: Contact Data is used for the Decision Split
Entry Source attributes are available in Journey Settings
Journey Data is used for the Decision Split
questions.e: Los Journey Data son una instantánea del momento de entrada; para ver cambios posteriores, el Decision Split debe usar datos de contacto (Contact Data).
questions.note: En la captura estaba marcada la C (Journey Data), pero los datos de entrada del journey se leen al entrar; como el campo se actualiza después, el Decision Split debe leer Contact Data (A). Respuesta corregida: revísala si tienes la solución oficial.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin is configuring Social Studio to manage social media accounts. What prerequisite for configuring Social Studio should the admin consider?
o: Facebook Ad Manager
Google URL shortener
Bitly URL shortener
questions.e: Para configurar Social Studio hace falta un acortador de URL de Bitly.

questions.q: A marketing manager requests to receive an email, once a week, with high-level metrics in a standardized format. Specifically, the manager wants to know how many emails were sent in the last week. What location and activity would allow the Marketing Cloud admin to complete this request?
o: Automation Studio: Create a Query Activity to query data from the "Sent" Data View, then use an Email activity to automate the sending of the data.
Analytics Builder: Select the "Account Send Summary" in Reports and schedule a weekly report to be sent.
Email Studio: Select the "Account Send Summary" in Tracking Reports and schedule a weekly report to be sent.
questions.e: El informe Account Send Summary de los Tracking Reports de Email Studio resume los envíos y puede programarse cada semana.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to pass the email address of a subscriber to a landing page through a URL parameter from a promotional email. Which Marketing Cloud capability allows for secure transmission of the email address?
o: CloudPagesURL AMPscript function
Web Analytics Connector
Link Wrapping
questions.e: La función AMPscript CloudPagesURL cifra los parámetros de la URL, de modo que el correo viaja de forma segura a la página.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters wants to drive additional online sales. They are interested in using Einstein to recommend similar items to customers during the checkout process. Which item would they add to their website to accomplish this?
o: Web Collect
Recommendation Code
Conversion/Cart Code
questions.e: Para mostrar recomendaciones de Einstein en la web se añade el código de recomendación (Recommendation Code) en la página.

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters is migrating from a small, in-house email solution to Marketing Cloud. What should the Marketing Cloud admin consider when sending from the new IP Address?
o: Sending ISPs notification of the new IP Address.
The IP address is on reserve, is already in use, and has an email sending history.
Building desirable sending history and data will be variable based on list size and engagement.
questions.e: Al enviar desde una IP nueva hay que avisar a los ISP de la nueva dirección y calentarla de forma progresiva.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin wants to automatically unsubscribe customers who respond to marketing emails asking to be removed from the mailing list. Which step should the admin take to enable this functionality?
o: Require Forwarding of Out of Office replies
Select Unsubscribe Manual Requests in Reply Mail Management
Ensure a Custom Response is enabled for Automated Response in Reply Mail Management
questions.e: En Reply Mail Management se configura la respuesta automática personalizada para gestionar a quienes responden pidiendo la baja.

questions.q: Northern Trails Outfitters wants to use complex criteria to identify subscribers for a special promotional email. Specifically, they want to target subscribers who opened or engaged with an email within the last 30 days and live within 10 miles of one of their stores. What should be used to create its audience?
o: Data Filters
SQL Query
Measures
questions.e: Las Measures permiten combinar criterios complejos, como la interacción reciente con emails y la ubicación, al construir la audiencia.

questions.q: When customers use the Marketing Cloud default Profile Center link to unsubscribe it causes users to not receive emails from any other business unit. What could explain this behavior?
o: The business unit unsubscribe setting causes an Enterprise level unsubscribe.
The user gets added to a blocklist that causes an Enterprise level unsubscribe.
The user gets added to an Exclusion Script.
questions.e: La baja desde el Profile Center predeterminado puede añadir al usuario a una lista de bloqueo con efecto a nivel de Enterprise, y deja de recibir correos de las demás unidades.

questions.q: A Contact Delete request has been processed for subscribers who have been sent to previously in a Northern Trail Outfitters' account. The action did NOT target all contacts in their account and a significant number of contacts that have been sent to remain. Which tracking data would still exist in the account?
o: General tracking data at the job level
Tracking extract contains subscriber-level data
Contact-specific data within the Tracking tab
questions.e: Al eliminar contactos se borra su información individual, pero se conservan los datos de seguimiento generales a nivel de envío (job).

questions.q: Northern Trail Outfitters placed an encrypted file on their Marketing Cloud SFTP for import into a data extension. They are using a File Transfer Activity to decrypt the file. Where would the decrypted data be after the File Transfer Activity completes?
o: Export SFTP folder
Selected SFTP folder
Safehouse
questions.e: Tras descifrar con la actividad File Transfer, el archivo queda en la carpeta SFTP seleccionada en la propia actividad.

questions.q: A Marketing Cloud admin notices out of the last several sends, Send Log data for a recent A/B test send was NOT recorded. How could the admin ensure send data is recorded?
o: Send Logging is available for A/B tests
Send Logging is enabled for the send
Correct Send Log template is selected
questions.e: Los datos del Send Log solo se registran si el Send Logging está activado para ese envío concreto.
